long_biography.plain_text:
Sarasota Ford became Matt Buchanan's proving ground after the financial crisis. After graduating from Stanford in science, technology and society, he began at Merrill Lynch in Boca Raton. When three family dealerships were underperforming, Buchanan accepted a one-year trial in the business, learned its operations and became dealer principal in 2011.

He reorganised the store around digital retailing and a less conventional showroom experience, adding product specialists, a café, theatre and rapid-service bays. Monthly vehicle sales rose from about 170 to more than 400 by 2016. A commercially rated helicopter and jet pilot, Buchanan also backs Sarasota-area youth and community initiatives through the dealership.
